ordered_diagnoses: Squamous cell carcinoma of the caruncle
Basal cell carcinoma of the caruncle

s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration
salient_findings: Amelanotic, pedunculated mass with ulcerated surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
key_facts: 4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
Lesion is amelanotic and pedunculated with an ulcerated surface
Lesion arises from the caruncle
No evidence of primary acquired melanosis (PAM)
Specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm with a 4-mm ulceration
Necrotic tissue present on the surface of the specimen
Solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Significant number of cycling cells shown by Ki-67 proliferation marker
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor

shortlist.label: Malignant melanoma of the caruncle
shortlist.why_kept: Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers and presence of large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the caruncle
shortlist.why_kept: Ulcerated surface and rapid growth of the lesion

shortlist.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Location of the lesion in the caruncle, which is rich in sebaceous glands

shortlist.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth and ulceration of the lesion, which are common features of Merkel cell carcinoma

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma of the caruncle
shortlist.why_kept: Location of the lesion in the caruncle and presence of a pedunculated mass

raw.rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, amelanotic, and pedunculated mass with ulceration, positive reactivity to melanocytic markers (HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A), and a high proliferative index (Ki-67) supports the diagnosis of malignant melanoma.

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the caruncle
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers for squamous cell carcinoma and presence of melanocytic markers

rejected.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
rejected.why: No indication of sebaceous gland origin or specific markers for this type of cancer

rejected.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of neuroendocrine markers or features typical of Merkel cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma of the caruncle
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic basal cell carcinoma histology and presence of melanocytic markers
